{{Quote|You want help, there's an aid station on the other side.''"<br />"''Other side? Of the ''mountains?"<br />"''Of the ''planet,'' stench! Start walking if you want to beat winter!|[[Zem (miner)|Zem]] and a disguised [[Zayne Carrick]]|<ref name="KotOR7" />}}
In [[3964 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanquo]] had an '''aid station''' that served [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] in need. The station was located on the other side of the planet from a [[Unidentified mining outpost|mining outpost]] visited that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] by fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]].<ref name="KotOR7" />
